articles.title: Fake Crypto Wallet App Spreads PamStealer Malware to Steal Mac Passwords
articles.summary:
A fake cryptocurrency wallet download is delivering a new version of PamStealer to Mac users. The attack starts with a convincing website whose installer asks visitors to follow instructions. Running the disguised file starts a hidden chain that can capture the Mac login password and other personal data. This is the third known PamStealer variant. […]
